title: Punters are people too
text: This is why punters matter in college football!

title: Jack's Punter Blog
text:
library(tidyverse)
  library(cfbfastR)
  library(gt)
  library(ggrepel)

  games <- read_csv("/Users/jackgrigsby/Downloads/footballlogs25 (16).csv")
  
  win_percent <- games |>
    group_by(team) |>
    summarise(
      games = n(),
      wins = sum(rslt == "W"),
      win_percent = round(mean(rslt == "W") * 100, 1)
    )

  punts <- load_cfb_pbp(2025) |>
    filter(punt == 1)

  punt_avg_length <- punts |>
    filter(yds_punted > 0) |>
    group_by(pos_team) |>
    summarise(
      average = mean(yds_punted)
    )

  plot_data_avg_length <- win_percent |>
    inner_join(
      punt_avg_length,
      by = c("team" = "pos_team")
    )

  highest_wins <- plot_data_avg_length |>
    filter(wins == max(wins))

  longest_avg_punt <- plot_data_avg_length |>
    filter(average == max(average))

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=plot_data_avg_length, aes(x = average, y = wins)) +
    geom_smooth(data=plot_data_avg_length, aes(x = average, y = wins), method = "lm") +
    geom_point(data = highest_wins, aes(x = average, y = wins), color = "darkred") +
    geom_text_repel(data = highest_wins, aes(x = average, y = wins, label = team), color = "darkred") +
    geom_point(data = longest_avg_punt, aes(x = average, y = wins), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_text_repel(data = longest_avg_punt, aes(x = average, y = wins, label = team), color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(
      title = "Long punts don't win games", 
      subtitle = "2025 college football season",  x = "Average punt length", y = "Number of wins",
      caption="Source: CFBfastR | By Jack Grigsby"
    ) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )









    punt_percentages <- punts |>
    group_by(pos_team) |>
    summarise(
      total_punts = n(),
      inside_20 = sum(yards_to_goal_end > 80),
      percent_inside_20 = round(inside_20 / total_punts * 100, 1),
    ) 

    plot_data_inside_20 <- win_percent |>
      inner_join(
      punt_percentages,
      by = c("team" = "pos_team")
    )
    
    highest_wins <- plot_data_inside_20 |>
      filter(wins == max(wins))

    highest_percent_inside_20_tn <- plot_data_inside_20 |>
      filter(percent_inside_20 == max(percent_inside_20)) |>
      filter(team == "Tennessee")
  
    highest_percent_inside_20_fl <- plot_data_inside_20 |>
      filter(percent_inside_20 == max(percent_inside_20)) |>
      filter(team == "Florida State")
        
    ggplot() +
      geom_point(data=plot_data_inside_20, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins)) +
      geom_smooth(data=plot_data_inside_20, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins), method = "lm") +
      geom_point(data = highest_wins, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins), color = "darkred") +
      geom_text_repel(data = highest_wins, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins, label = team), color = "darkred") +
      geom_point(data = highest_percent_inside_20_tn, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins), color = "orange") +
      geom_text_repel(data = highest_percent_inside_20_tn, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins, label = team), color = "orange") +
      geom_point(data = highest_percent_inside_20_fl, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins), color = "gold") +
      geom_text_repel(data = highest_percent_inside_20_fl, aes(x = percent_inside_20, y = wins, label = team), color = "gold") +
        labs( 
        title = "Punts inside the 20 don't help much", 
        subtitle = "2025 college football season",  x = "Percentage of punts inside the 20", y = "Number of wins",
        caption="Source: CFBfastR | By Jack Grigsby"
      ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )









  wins_and_rushing <- games |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    wins = sum(rslt == "W"),
    average_yards_per_game = round(mean(rushing_yds), 1)
  )

  highest_wins <- wins_and_rushing |>
    filter(wins == max(wins))

  highest_rushing_yards <- wins_and_rushing |>
    filter(average_yards_per_game == max(average_yards_per_game))

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data=wins_and_rushing, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins)) +
    geom_smooth(data=wins_and_rushing, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins), method = "lm") +      
    geom_point(data = highest_wins, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins), color = "darkred") +
    geom_text_repel(data = highest_wins, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins, label = team), color = "darkred") +
    geom_point(data = highest_rushing_yards, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins), color = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = highest_rushing_yards, aes(x = average_yards_per_game, y = wins, label = team), color = "darkblue") +
    labs(
    title = "Rushing yards win games", 
      subtitle = "2025 college football season",  x = "Average rushing yards", y = "Number of wins",
      caption="Source: CFBfastR | By Jack Grigsby"
    ) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )









big10_punts <- punts |>
  filter(
    (
      pos_team == "Illinois" |
      pos_team == "Indiana" |
      pos_team == "Iowa" |
      pos_team == "Maryland" |
      pos_team == "Michigan" |
      pos_team == "Michigan State" |
      pos_team == "Minnesota" |
      pos_team == "Nebraska" |
      pos_team == "Northwestern" |
      pos_team == "Ohio State" |
      pos_team == "Oregon" |
      pos_team == "Penn State" |
      pos_team == "Purdue" |
      pos_team == "Rutgers" |
      pos_team == "UCLA" |
      pos_team == "USC" |
      pos_team == "Washington" |
      pos_team == "Wisconsin"
    ) 
  )  

  big10_punt_epa <- big10_punts |>
  group_by(pos_team) |>
  summarise(
    total_punts = n(),
    average_punt_epa = round(mean(EPA), 3)
  )

  rutgers_punt_epa <- big10_punt_epa |>
    filter(pos_team == "Rutgers")
  
  purdue_punt_epa <- big10_punt_epa |>
    filter(pos_team == "Purdue")
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_bar(data=big10_punt_epa, aes(x = pos_team, weight = average_punt_epa), fill="lightgrey") +
    geom_bar(data=rutgers_punt_epa, aes(x = pos_team, weight = average_punt_epa), fill="red") +
    geom_bar(data=purdue_punt_epa, aes(x = pos_team, weight = average_punt_epa), fill="gold") +
    coord_flip() + 
    labs( 
      title = "Only two Big Ten teams have a positive punting EPA", 
      subtitle = "2025 college football season",  x = "Team", y = "EPA",
      caption="Source: CFBfastR | By Jack Grigsby"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot"
    )









  all_team_epas <- punts |>
    group_by(pos_team) |>
    summarise(
      average_punt_epa = round(mean(EPA), 2)
    ) |>
    arrange(average_punt_epa)
  
  all_team_epas |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      pos_team = "School",
      average_punt_epa = "Average Punt EPA"
    ) |>
    tab_header(
      title = "Average punting EPA from worst to best",
      subtitle = "2025 college football season"
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", align = "center", size = "25"),
      locations = cells_title("title")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", align = "center", size = "15"),
      locations = cells_title("subtitle")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(color = "darkgreen", weight = "bold")
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = average_punt_epa,
        rows = average_punt_epa > 0
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(color = "darkred", weight = "bold")
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = average_punt_epa,
        rows = average_punt_epa < 0
      )
    ) |>
    tab_source_note(source_note = "By Jack Grigsby") |>
    tab_source_note(source_note = "CFBfastR")
